content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy is popular for its ease of use, particularly for selling digital products. It allows creators to set up shops quickly, but its availability is constrained to certain regions. Stripe facilitates payments seamlessly but operates in only 46 countries, leaving many creators without access. PayPal, while widely known, often suspends accounts without warning, leading to cash flow disruptions. Conversely, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides creators full ownership and control, ensuring they can operate their businesses independently of these restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and PayPal both exclude numerous countries, which isn't just a minor inconvenience; it's a fundamental barrier to entry for many creators. When PayPal suspends accounts, funds can be held for up to 180 days without any recourse for appeal, leaving creators in dire financial situations. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to bypass these restrictions entirely. By utilizing decentralized tools like NOWPayments for crypto processing, creators can accept payments from anywhere, eliminating the limitations imposed by traditional payment platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Standard platforms often impose high fees and slow payment processes, which can eat into a creator's revenue. Stripe and PayPal typically charge transaction fees ranging from 2.9% + 30¢ to upwards of 5%, depending on the region. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions such as NOWPayments charge only a 0.5% fee with no KYC requirements, offering a more economical approach. Furthermore, payment confirmations via blockchain are immediate, ensuring that creators receive funds without unnecessary delays.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is your path to autonomy in digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms like Lemon Squeezy, creators often do not fully own their data or the infrastructure they rely on. This can lead to vulnerabilities, such as sudden changes in terms of service or suspension of accounts. Sovereign commerce architecture ensures that once deployed, creators own all components, including their customer data and payment systems. This infrastructure guarantees automated processes for order fulfillment and payment confirmations, allowing creators to focus on their work without worrying about third-party disruptions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, the choice is clear: traditional platforms are not viable. Instead, leveraging an Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is advisable. This stack combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, providing a reliable and autonomous system that supports up to five products. It ensures SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations are in place and undergoes thorough end-to-end testing before handoff. Creators can rest assured with 30 days of support to address any initial concerns.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Avoid account suspensions and fund holds with decentralized payment solutions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
